policy: Shared Legends layout, selected before reserved rules areas were inspected. Actual production painter agrees exactly with the frozen proposal on 104 cards. Old baseline and final production replay share the corrected scan poses; gold geometry and land frame shadow preservation also changed between these two captures. Scores are text-region overlap, not full-card compliance.

coverage.policy: Complete original and Oracle layout coverage using frozen cached Scryfall and MTGJSON inputs, all 310 printings including frame-registration rejections. No image fitting or score selection. Original printing breaks and flavor retained; no text truncation.

remaining: Sentinel compact wrapping differs after the fourth line. A global compact font increase regresses other dense cards.
Fallen Angel has manual mixed center/left alignment within one printed paragraph.
Dream Coat has different compact line spacing and flavor placement.
Full-set release evaluation is recorded separately in legends-fullset.json.
